lessons.claim: Store a dimensionless number as a number only and nobody can catch 'the name says dt/τ_int but the value is something else'. Have Group(name, value, num=(cat,symbol), den=(cat,symbol)) point at the ledger entries and have validate() recompute the ratio and compare, and a label error gets caught. It caught 1 on the very first real use: soft-r3's ledger wrote U(d) as 'A kT' when it is actually (A+ε_WCA)kT -- at r=d the WCA gives exactly ε (4ε(1−1)+ε). At A=100 that is 101, a 1% discrepancy.
